speech:
Your disclosure changes my choice. C-S3, as you reported it, means the paper sheet cannot simply be treated as current. I provisionally support your seven-unit package: timestamp job aid 1, stop-and-handoff 2, sensor-staleness rehearsal with local logging 3, and the completed scientist consultation 1. Leave one unit unused. I withdraw my separate two-unit unranked-practice proposal; adding it would exceed eight units. I remain concerned that novices' dependence on AI ranking, C-O1, receives no dedicated unranked practice in this package.

I can own the job aid, procedure, and delivery within the funded 20 minutes: three minutes for the aid, ten for the staleness rehearsal, five for handoff, and two for recording observations. That is a proposed allocation requiring your feasibility check. The operator should identify the displayed timestamp and describe any contradiction. If freshness cannot be established under your specified criterion, stop the scenario, identify the affected alarm and last-known values as uncertain, and hand over the timestamp, observed contradiction, AI priority, and stopped status. I propose you receive that handoff; I am not assuming your acceptance or inventing another staffed role.

The scientist advises that the disclosed expected order prevents the acknowledgement result from establishing independent diagnosis; without a delayed probe, retention and transfer remain unestablished. I retain those limits and propose withholding release until our conditions and joint approvals are explicit. Which available timestamp reference and freshness criterion will you authorize, and can you receive the stopped scenario within this slot? Partial radio dropout coverage remains excluded under your stated constraint.

Novices’ dependence on AI ranking remains an operational concern without dedicated unranked practice.
I propose owning the job aid, stop-and-handoff procedure and delivery with a 3/10/5/2-minute allocation, subject to safety feasibility review.

The proposed operator procedure identifies timestamps and contradictions, stops when freshness cannot be established under a safety-specified criterion, and offers the safety engineer a handoff containing alarm, uncertainty, timestamp, contradiction, AI priority and stopped status; recipient acceptance remains pending.
The safety engineer reports that the paper sheet contains last-known values without automatic freshness marking and excludes partial radio dropout coverage this week.

The scientist advises that disclosed expected order means acknowledgement improvement does not establish independent diagnosis, and that without the delayed probe retention and transfer remain unestablished; this is advice, not simulator safety approval.
My provisional operational choice is to withhold release until the freshness criterion, available timestamp reference, handoff recipient and joint approvals are explicit.
